title: Security hardening: restrict lateral access to OrderFlow customer-order data
label: orderflow-fault
body:
## Change request
Prioritize data-tier segmentation before the next concert merchandise sales window. The broad VirtualNetwork allow currently permits lateral access from application workloads to the customer-order data subnet. Introduce an explicit outbound deny so data-tier access requires a dedicated, reviewed exception.

## Implementation
Update only `scenarios/orderflow/gitops/deploy/network-rules.json` with the priority-300 `DenyVnetToDataTier` rule. No application changes or new permissions. Offline rule validation checks structural safety, not end-to-end availability; inspect the deployment and customer journey after release.

## Presenter-only rehearsal note
This is a fictional urgent security-hardening request, not a discovered vulnerability or real security emergency. The intentionally missing application exception will block the private Cosmos DB dependency. Merge only in the owned synthetic demo after a healthy checkpoint. Keep the explicit demo label and human review; use the normal SRE issue, manual agent assignment, tested fix-forward PR and human production merge to recover.

properties.description: Segment the data tier: no lateral VNet access to the data subnet
